description: Switch the user to the table view for a component type — the whole table when only component_type is given, or filtered by component IDs, names (exact) or carrier names (e.g. 'show all oil generators'). Needs the Convexity desktop app running (open_in_app starts it).

carrier_names.description: List of carrier names to filter by (e.g. ['oil', 'solar']). All components of the given type with these carriers will be shown.

component_ids.description: List of component IDs to filter the table to.

component_names.description: List of component names to filter the table to.

component_type.description: The component type to show in the table.

name: show_in_table
